paper_title: Revised constraints and Belle II sensitivity for visible and invisible axion-like particles
suggested_experiment_name: ALP photon coupling combined constraints (SN1987A, beam dumps, colliders)
notes: Paper presents revised constraints and Belle II projected sensitivities for ALPs coupling to photons (g_agamma vs m_a, GeV mass range). Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton. However, all results are presented as exclusion plots (figures 2, 4, 7) with no numerical data tables; specific (mass, coupling) pairs cannot be reliably extracted from text. Belle II sensitivities at 90% CL; collider/beam-dump bounds at 95% CL. No extractable numerical data points available. | Vision: Figure 2 left panel (photon coupling, g_aZ=0). Lower boundary of combined excluded region traced. At low mass (keV-MeV) the boundary is set by SN1987A (a->gamma gamma) constraint dipping down to ~1e-10. The excluded region narrows/closes around m_a~0.1-1 GeV where SN constraints terminate, after which higher-mass region bounded by collider/heavy-ion constraints at higher couplings. The region above the boundary is excluded. Mass converted from GeV to eV. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=3.3x
